response.sql: SELECT MediaType.Name, AVG(Track.UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Track.Milliseconds) FROM Track INNER JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId WHERE Track.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaType.Name

assumptions.assumption: "keep only the large files" with threshold 10323804 is interpreted as Bytes >= 10323804 (at or above threshold) rather than Bytes > 10323804 (strictly above threshold)

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold could denote files strictly larger than the cutoff (Bytes > 10323804) rather than at-or-above
